description: This file declares functions and types for managing Git reflogs in the libgit2 library, including reading, writing, appending, renaming, deleting, and accessing reflog entries.

methods.name: git_reflog_read
methods.description: Reads the reflog for a given reference in a repository, returning an empty reflog if none exists.

methods.name: git_reflog_write
methods.description: Writes an in-memory reflog object back to disk atomically.

methods.name: git_reflog_append
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the in-memory reflog with specified commit ID, signature, and message.

methods.name: git_reflog_rename
methods.description: Renames an existing reflog for a reference, checking for name validity.

methods.name: git_reflog_delete
methods.description: Deletes the reflog for a specified reference.

methods.name: git_reflog_entrycount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in a reflog.

methods.name: git_reflog_entry_byindex
methods.description: Retrieves a reflog entry by its index, with index 0 being the most recent.

methods.name: git_reflog_drop
methods.description: Removes a reflog entry by index, optionally rewriting previous entries to maintain continuity.

methods.name: git_reflog_entry_id_old
methods.description: Gets the old object ID from a reflog entry.

methods.name: git_reflog_entry_id_new
methods.description: Gets the new object ID from a reflog entry.

methods.name: git_reflog_entry_committer
methods.description: Retrieves the committer signature for a reflog entry.

methods.name: git_reflog_entry_message
methods.description: Gets the log message associated with a reflog entry.

methods.name: git_reflog_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a reflog object.
